desc: CinnaGraham Toast Crunch is a delicious, CINNADUST blasted breakfast cereal from Cinnamon Toast Crunch. With every spoonful, you can enjoy the honey sweet flavor of graham crackers with the iconic cinnamon taste of Cinnamon Toast Crunch. Crunchy and irresistibly delicious, it's perfect as part of breakfast, snack time, or whenever. CinnaGraham Toast Crunch breakfast cereal is made with whole grain wheat and provides 13g whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily), 12 vitamins and minerals, and is a good source of calcium - ideal for kids or teens. If you're looking for a quick and easy kids breakfast idea, it doesn't get more awesome than this. Just pour a serving of this sweetened wheat and corn cereal, splash on some milk, and enjoy. And don't forget to drink the CINNAMILK, the treasured cereal milk found at the bottom of your cereal bowl. Enjoy by the bowlful or serve as kids snacks by the handful. Pack some in a school snack bag for on the go. Or enjoy some cold cereal as an evening treat. However you enjoy it, General Mills breakfast cereals are always ready to spread goodness from tots to grow-ups.
features:
GRAHAM CRACKER TASTE: Sweet honey graham cracker flavor with a blast of CINNADUST, that irresistible combo of cinnamon and sugar

WHOLE GRAIN: 13g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), 12 vitamins and minerals per serving, and a good source of calcium; Made with swirls of real cinnamon

PART OF BREAKFAST OR SNACK: Enjoy some with milk or by itself as a tasty addition to breakfast, snack time, or whenever

SWEET TREATS: Makes a delicious addition to homemade cereal bars, party snacks, an ice cream toppings bar, and more

CONTAINS: One 12 oz box of CinnaGraham Toast Crunch Cereal
ingredients:
Whole Grain Wheat, Corn Meal, Sugar, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Fructose, Dextrose, Cinnamon, Brown Sugar Syrup, Baking Soda, Salt, Soy Lecithin, Trisodium Phosphate, Caramel Color, Artificial Flavor, Rosemary Extract. BHT Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.

Contains wheat and soy ingredients.
